entities.name: Josef Straßberger
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Josef Straßberger was a German weightlifter who competed at the 1928 and 1932 Olympic Games. He won the gold medal in the heavyweight division in Amsterdam and the bronze medal in the same division in Los Angeles. He was born in Kolbermoor, Bavaria and died in Munich.
